summary: Contrasts role defaults (easily overridden) with role vars (used in the role, hard to override except by params or -e), and recommends passing variables as role params for clarity, including running a role multiple times with different values.
questions: What's the difference between role defaults and role vars?
How do I pass variables to a role?
How do I run the same role several times with different values?

answer_card.title: Role defaults, role vars and role parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `roles/x/defaults/main.yml`: used if nothing else is set; easy to override.
- `roles/x/vars/main.yml`: "will absolutely be used"; only role params or `-e` override it.
- Pass params for clarity:

```yaml
roles:
   - role: apache
     vars:
        http_port: 8080
   - role: app_user
     vars:
        myname: Ian
   - role: app_user
     vars:
        myname: Terry
```

Variables set in one role are available to later roles.
